arxiv-2601-02494.title: Dynamical Origins of Azimuthal Metallicity Variations in the Galactic Disk: Insights from Kinematic Ridges with Gaia
arxiv-2601-02494.creator: Carlos Jurado, Keith Hawkins, Jason A. S. Hunt, Zoe Hackshaw, Carrie Filion, Neige Frankel, Christopher Carr
arxiv-2601-02494.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Carlos Jurado, Keith Hawkins, Jason A. S. Hunt, Zoe Hackshaw, Carrie Filion, Neige Frankel, Christopher Carr. Kinematic and spectroscopic studies in the past few years have revealed coherent azimuthal metallicity variations across the Milky Way’s disk that may be the result of dynamical process associated with non-axisymmetric features of the Galaxy. At the same time, stellar kinematics from Gaia have uncovered ridge-like features in the velocity space, raising the question of whether these chemical and dynamical substructures share a common origin.

pmc-12746739.title: Carnitine and Other Metabolites in Fibromyalgia a Clinical Perspective on a Mendelian Randomization Study

pmc-12746739.description: BackgroundFibromyalgia (FM) is a chronic pain disorder lacking reliable biomarkers.
